about.zh: 由两个数构造方向向量 (x, y)
about.en: A direction vector (x, y) from two numbers

shared.zh: 由前、中、后三个数构造权重向量
shared.en: A first/centre/last weight vector from three numbers

shared.zh: 按给定尺度生成归一化的一维高斯权重
shared.en: A normalised Gaussian row at the selected scale

about.en: Five weights arranged in a row

shared.zh: 沿方向 d 按前、中、后权重向量汇合三格读数
shared.en: Three samples along d combined with a first/centre/last weight vector

shared.zh: 图外：取 0、延续边缘、周期延续、镜像延续
shared.en: outside: zero, replicate, periodic, reflect

about.zh: a ÷ b，逐个值；除以 0 报错
about.en: a ÷ b, value by value; dividing by 0 stops

about.zh: a < b 为 1，否则为 0，逐个值
about.en: 1 where a < b, else 0, value by value

shared.zh: 从 x 轴转到 (x, y) 的方向，以周为单位（−1/2 到 1/2），逐个值；参数顺序 (y, x)
shared.en: the direction of (x, y) from the x axis in turns (−1/2 to 1/2), value by value; arguments (y, x)

shared.zh: 平方根，逐个值；负数报错
shared.en: square root, value by value; a negative number stops

about.zh: cos(2πa)：a 以周为单位，逐个值
about.en: cos(2πa), a in turns, value by value

shared.zh: 条件不为 0 取 yes，否则取 no，逐个值
shared.en: yes where the condition is not 0, else no, value by value

about.zh: w × h 的图，每格是它的 x
about.en: a w × h image, each cell its x

about.zh: w × h 的图，每格是它的 y
about.en: a w × h image, each cell its y

shared.zh: 在图的 (x, y) 处取值：数取一个值，坐标图取同样大小的一张图；坐标须为整数
shared.en: the image at (x, y): one value at numbers, an image at coordinate images; whole numbers only

about.zh: 图外：报错、取 0、取最近的边
about.en: outside: stop, read 0, read the nearest edge

shared.zh: 彩色像素里第 c 个位置组成的灰度图
shared.en: the grey image of position c of each colour pixel

shared.zh: 三张同样大小的灰度图拼成彩色图
shared.en: three grey images of one size made one colour image

shared.zh: 按连续坐标采样：最近邻或双线性
shared.en: sample at continuous coordinates: nearest or bilinear

shared.zh: 沿一条轴对三格邻域按 a、b、c 加权
shared.en: three neighbours along one axis weighted by a, b, c

about.zh: 用核计算互相关或数学卷积
about.en: a kernel applied as correlation or convolution

about.zh: RGB 三个通道按 wr、wg、wb 加权相加
about.en: RGB weighted by wr, wg, wb and added

about.zh: 输出 (x, y) 读输入 (x, y) + d
about.en: output (x, y) reads input (x, y) + d

shared.zh: 训练时会被改动的参数：shape 是 scalar（一个数）、row3（三个权重）、kernel3 或 kernel5（方形的核），value 是学到的值（还没学时是 0）
shared.en: a parameter training changes: shape scalar (one number), row3 (three weights), kernel3 or kernel5 (a square kernel); value is what it learned (0 before any training)

shared.zh: 和输入的图一样大的一张参数图（每格一个权重），value 是学到的值
shared.en: a parameter image the size of the input (a weight a cell); value is what it learned

about.en: the sum of every cell of an image

shared.zh: 一张灰度图的每格变成概率：exp 后除以总和
shared.en: each cell of a grey image made a probability: exp, divided by the total

about.zh: e 的 a 次方，逐个值
about.en: e to the power a, value by value

shared.zh: 自然对数，逐个值；不是正数报错
shared.en: the natural logarithm, value by value; a number not above 0 stops

shared.zh: 灰度图的幅度谱，零频在中心
shared.en: a grey image’s amplitude spectrum, frequency 0 in the centre

shared.zh: 每个频率乘以增益图在它那一格的值（零频在中心），再变回图
shared.en: each frequency times the gain drawn at its cell (frequency 0 in the centre), back to an image

shared.zh: 和频谱同样排布的每格横向频率（每张图几个周期）
shared.en: each cell’s horizontal frequency, laid out like the spectrum (cycles per image)

shared.zh: 和频谱同样排布的每格纵向频率（每张图几个周期）
shared.en: each cell’s vertical frequency, laid out like the spectrum (cycles per image)

shared.zh: 两个方向都每隔 step 格取一格，从 (0, 0) 起
shared.en: every step-th cell along both axes, from (0, 0)

shared.zh: 每个输出位置的邻域读数，一行一个位置
shared.en: each output position’s window samples, a row a position

about.zh: 和 windowSamples 对应的权重

shared.zh: 一列逐位置结果还原为 shape 的宽高
shared.en: a column of per-position results laid out at shape’s size

about.zh: 四边按半径 r 去掉
重复后每格的位置 x/N
重复后每行的索引 k

about.en: parts that read, lay out and transform images
parts that work on numbers and vectors

shared.zh: 把图的值照抄进同样大小的空格子
shared.en: copy the image’s values into an empty grid of its size

shared.zh: 填一张和 rows 一样大的格子，填成 rows（采样位置、显示出来的值……）
shared.en: fill a grid the size of `rows` with them (sample positions, the values shown…)

shared.zh: 画出两条等长的条：上面 old 个旧像素（标出中心和边界的 x），下面 new 个新像素平分同一段长度；玩家填的 x 标在旧像素的条上
shared.en: draws two bars of one length: `old` old pixels above (their centres and edges marked in x), `new` new pixels sharing the same length below; the x the player fills in is marked on the old bar

about.zh: 点出坐标 (x, y) 的那一格

shared.zh: 高亮的是 (x, y) 那一格：写出它的坐标
shared.en: the cell (x, y) is highlighted: write its coordinates

shared.zh: 把像素 (x, y) 改成 value，别的格子不动
shared.en: change the pixel (x, y) to `value`, every other cell as it was

shared.zh: 每题写明的答案（items 的 answer）
shared.en: each item’s answer as written (an item’s `answer`)

shared.zh: 选项给出的字段（gives）够不够回答题目要的（needs）：exact 要刚好够（最少的那个），enough 只要够
shared.en: whether an option’s fields (`gives`) answer what the item needs (`needs`): exact wants the least that is enough, enough any that is enough

about.zh: 题目的 is 和选项的 is 相同

shared.zh: 每题是一句论断（claim），在这一轮的每个候选场景（scenes）里算真假：都真为成立，都假为不成立，有真有假为无法确定
shared.en: each item is a claim, true or false in each of the round’s candidate scenes: supported when true in all, contradicted when false in all, else undetermined

shared.zh: 选几个情形，合起来要覆盖 needs 里的每一种变化（选项的 varies），每个选中的都要带来别的没覆盖的变化
shared.en: choose cases that together cover every change in `needs` (an option’s `varies`), each bringing a change the others do not

shared.zh: 选出推翻「每个预测都对」的情形（选项的 predicted 和 truth 不同）；都对时选 id 为 none 的选项
shared.en: choose a case refuting “every prediction is right” (an option whose `predicted` differs from its `truth`); when all are right, the option with id none

shared.zh: 题目和选项量的是同一种东西（measures 相同）
shared.en: the item and the option measure the same thing (equal `measures`)

shared.zh: 候选场景（选项的 scene）和参照场景（reference）只差在 vary 那一样：全部选出
shared.en: every candidate scene (an option’s `scene`) that differs from the reference only in `vary`

shared.zh: 选出两组以上（选项的 H、Z）：在焦距 f 下像高都是 target，距离又各不相同
shared.en: choose two or more pairs (an option’s H and Z) that all image at height `target` under focal length f, at different depths

about.en: an object of a class is there

about.zh: 某类物体正好有 n 个
about.en: exactly n objects of a class

about.zh: 某个物体在画面里看得见
about.en: an object shows in the picture
an object is of a class

shared.zh: 某个物体离相机（沿光轴）这么远
shared.en: an object is this far from the camera (along its axis)

about.en: an object is of a colour

about.zh: 每个像素各自的值（逐像素的图）
about.en: a value for every pixel (a per-pixel map)

about.zh: 分得出各个物体（谁是谁）

shared.zh: 针孔相机（理想几何模型，虚像平面不倒像）：旋钮 X（横向位置）、H（物高）、Z（距离）、f（像平面距离）；算出投影位置 u、像高 h；可以放几个物体，可以加一块传感器（毫米和像素的尺寸），读出像素值、像素焦距 fpx、视场 fov 和哪些物体在画面里
shared.en: the pinhole camera (an ideal geometric model, the upright virtual image plane): knobs X (lateral offset), H (object height), Z (depth), f (plane distance); computes the projection u and the image height h; may hold several objects and a sensor (its size in millimetres and pixels), reading pixels, the focal length in pixels fpx, the field of view fov and which objects are in view

shared.zh: 画成一个点（看 u）还是一支箭（看 h）
shared.en: drawn as a point (u matters) or an arrow (h matters)

shared.zh: 几支竖着的箭，各从 X 到 X + H；不写 Z 的用旋钮 Z
shared.en: several upright arrows, each from X to X + H; one without Z stands at the knob Z

shared.zh: 传感器：高和宽（毫米、像素），主点在中心
shared.en: the sensor: its height and width in millimetres and in pixels, the principal point at its centre

shared.zh: 像平面上画出的目标位置（像素的目标要有传感器）
shared.en: the target drawn on the image plane (a target in pixels needs a sensor)

shared.zh: 薄透镜（简化教学模型，毫米）：旋钮 A（光圈直径）、focus（对焦距离）；算出进光量 light、每个物体的模糊圈 blur_<id> 和清晰与否 sharp_<id>、清晰的深度范围 near–far（dof）
shared.en: the thin lens (a simplified teaching model, millimetres): knobs A (aperture diameter) and focus (focus distance); computes the light, each object’s blur circle blur_<id> and sharpness sharp_<id>, the sharp depth range near–far (dof)

about.zh: 进光量为 1 时的光圈直径
about.en: the aperture whose light counts as 1

about.zh: 还算清晰的最大模糊圈直径
about.en: the largest blur circle still judged sharp

shared.zh: 一行亮度看成波（教学模型）：wave 模式对齐一道目标波（旋钮 k、amp、phase，读数 error）；step 模式用奇次正弦逼近台阶（旋钮 a1、a3…，读数 error、overshoot）；sampling 模式隔 step 格采样 k 个周期的条纹（读数 perCycle、seen、aliased）
shared.en: a row of brightness as waves (a teaching model): wave mode matches a target wave (knobs k, amp, phase; reads error); step mode approaches a step with odd sines (knobs a1, a3…; reads error, overshoot); sampling mode samples k-cycle stripes every `step` cells (reads perCycle, seen, aliased)

shared.zh: 灯下的哑光面（朗伯教学模型，侧视）：每块面的旋钮 albedo_<id>（反射率）、tilt_<id>（朝向，度），灯的 light（方向，度）和 intensity；读出 brightness_<id>、brighter、whiter 和画成一条的 patches
shared.en: matte patches under a light (a Lambertian teaching model, side view): per patch knobs albedo_<id> (reflectance) and tilt_<id> (facing, degrees), the light’s `light` (direction, degrees) and intensity; reads brightness_<id>, brighter, whiter and the strip `patches`

shared.zh: 只在模型的这个量为真时显示
shared.en: shown only while this quantity of the model is true

about.en: sticks to the bottom on a phone

about.zh: 第一列窄，手机上也并排
about.en: a narrow first column, side by side on a phone too
each only as wide as it needs

shared.zh: 目标达到没有；分步的台子带「下一步」
shared.en: whether the goal holds; a stepped bench adds “next step”

about.zh: 目标的每一条和此刻的值
about.en: each limit of the goal and its value now
switch between the cases, each marked passed or not

shared.zh: 模型给出的 { lines, dots, legend }
shared.en: the model’s { lines, dots, legend }

about.zh: 曲线图：指向一处读出各条线的值
about.en: a line plot: point at a spot to read every line

about.zh: 几行像素，最暗是 0，最亮是 1
about.en: rows of pixels, darkest at 0 and lightest at 1

shared.zh: 一段字：写定的，或模型算出的
shared.en: a line of words: written, or computed by the model

shared.zh: 等比例的竖直视场构图，标出上下边界和半角
shared.en: an equal-scale vertical field-of-view construction, with both sensor edges and half-angle

shared.zh: 针孔相机的侧视图：物体、相机中心、虚像平面和穿过中心的光线，目标位置画在像平面上
shared.en: the pinhole camera from the side: the object, the camera centre, the virtual image plane and the rays through the centre, the target drawn on the plane

shared.zh: 薄透镜的侧视图：物体、透镜、传感器和每个物体落在传感器上的光锥
shared.en: the thin lens from the side: the objects, the lens, the sensor and each object’s cone of light on the sensor

shared.zh: 模糊圈对深度的曲线：清晰门槛、清晰的深度范围和每个物体的位置
shared.en: the blur circle against depth: the sharpness threshold, the sharp range and each object

shared.zh: 学到的参数：数或一小块数表，只读，训练改动它
shared.en: a learned parameter: a number or a small table of numbers, read only, changed by training

shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up building, not how many levels

shared.zh: 几套托盘：每套是一串元件，按托盘上的先后排；关卡用其中一套，托盘上的元件在带来它或搭出它的那一关之后可用。不写时每关拿到见过的所有元件
shared.en: the trays: each a list of parts in the order it shows them; a level plays with one, and a part on it is usable after the level that brings it in or builds it. Without, every level holds every part it has met

about.zh: 几个元件合起来是一个新概念
about.en: parts that are one new idea together

shared.zh: 能用的显示方式，第一种是起始；只有一种时玩家不能切换
shared.en: the views it may be drawn in, the first to start in; with one, the player cannot switch

shared.zh: 每种形状默认的显示方式（没写的用库里的第一种）
shared.en: the views each shape is drawn in by default (the library’s first where none is given)

shared.zh: 引言或通关文案旁显示的一个值
shared.en: a value shown beside an introduction page or a pass text

about.en: a value shown beside the pass text

shared.zh: 这一关（这个任务）用的托盘；游戏只有一套托盘时不用写
shared.en: the tray this level (task) plays with; a game of one tray need not say

shared.zh: 元件上的设置：parts.json 里同名的预设，传给板里有同一个设置的元件
shared.en: settings on the part: the presets of these names in parts.json, passed to every card inside with the same setting

shared.zh: 这些设置的起始值（不写用预设的）
shared.en: what those settings start as (the preset’s where left out)

shared.zh: 通过后最后一个任务的板成为元件 type（最后一个任务必须是电路）
shared.en: once passed the last task’s board is the part `type` (the last task must be a circuit)

shared.zh: 新元件第一次出现时只放它一个也算一关：为什么
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only places it: why

shared.zh: 任务的 id：整款游戏里唯一，玩家存下的板跟着它走（只有一个任务的关通常就用关的 id）
shared.en: the task’s id, unique in the game; what a player keeps of it goes by it (a level’s one task usually has the level’s id)

shared.zh: 这个任务的名字，写在任务条上（一关只有一个任务时不显示）
shared.en: the task’s name on the strip of tasks (not shown when the level has one task)

shared.zh: 本任务引入的配置：元件.设置 → 取值列表；*.outside 表示共同的边界假设
shared.en: Introduced enum values by part.setting; *.outside is a shared boundary assumption

about.zh: 这次升级留下的管线分段名称
about.en: the pipeline stage this upgrade contributes

shared.zh: 这个任务自己的引言：第一次做到它时读（第一个任务的接在这一关的后面）
shared.en: the task’s own intro: read the first time it is played (the first task’s after the level’s)

shared.zh: 这个任务通过时说的话（最后一个任务用这一关的点题）
shared.en: what passing the task says (the last task says the level’s pass text)

shared.zh: 测试旁可展开的成像场景，不增加通关步骤
shared.en: an inspectable camera scene beside a test, without another assessment step

shared.zh: 这个口的值起初画成哪种显示方式（玩家在详情和结果区里换）
shared.en: the view its value starts in (the player switches it in its detail and results row)

shared.zh: 二维向量 { x, y }：成对的坐标量是一个输入
shared.en: a two-dimensional vector { x, y }: a paired coordinate quantity is one input

about.en: a grey image: a row of numbers per row

about.zh: 彩色图：每行一列 [R, G, B]
about.en: a colour image: a row of [R, G, B] per row

shared.zh: 每个输入或输出的值，按名字：数、「—」（null）、图或坐标点 {x,y}
shared.en: a value for each input or output by name: a number, 「—」 (null), an image or a point {x,y}

shared.zh: 隐藏测试：每次运行一并检查，通关后公开；只合上可见测试的板过不了它
shared.en: hidden tests: checked with every run and shown once passed; a board that only fits the visible tests fails them

about.zh: 一块板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: 直觉上的错解：看起来能做、其实过不了这个任务的板，必须失败
shared.en: the naive answer: a board that looks right and is not, which must fail

about.zh: 显示哪一项：任务的一个口
about.en: what the row shows: one of the task’s ports

shared.zh: 结果区的几行，按顺序；不写就是领域默认的几行
shared.en: the results area’s rows, in order; without them the domain’s default rows

shared.zh: 这个任务里每种形状的显示方式（换掉游戏默认的那几种）
shared.en: the views each shape is drawn in in this task (in place of the game’s)

shared.zh: 比较值时的容差（默认 1e-5）
shared.en: the tolerance values are compared with (1e-5 by default)

shared.zh: 训练用的例子：输入和应当的输出
shared.en: the examples it trains on: inputs and the outputs wanted

shared.zh: 不参与训练、只看误差的例子（验证集）
shared.en: examples it is never trained on, only measured on (the validation set)

shared.zh: 验证误差这么多轮没有变好就停，留下最好的那一轮
shared.en: stop once the validation loss has not improved for this many epochs, keeping the best

shared.zh: 训练任务：判定之前先训练板上可学习的参数；测试判的是训练后的板
shared.en: a training task: the board’s learnable parameters are trained before judging; the tests judge the trained board

shared.zh: argmax：分类器只看最可能的那一类对不对
shared.en: argmax: a classifier is judged only on whether its most likely class is right

shared.zh: 任务开始时的板，蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
shared.en: the board the task opens on, as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: 沿用指定先修关卡最后通关的电路，直接扩展其内部元件
shared.en: extend the last passed board of the named prerequisite directly

about.zh: 从上一个任务的板开始
about.en: start from the task before’s board

shared.zh: 圆盘：圆心 (cx, cy)、半径 r、亮度 v
shared.en: a disc: centre (cx, cy), radius r, value v

shared.zh: 矩形：左上角 (x, y)、宽 w、高 h
shared.en: a rectangle: top left (x, y), w wide, h high

shared.zh: 整张图沿一个轴从 from 渐变到 to
shared.en: the whole picture graded from `from` to `to` along an axis

shared.zh: 条纹：每 period 格一个周期，axis x 是竖条；可限在一块区域里
shared.en: stripes, a cycle every period cells, upright for axis x; optionally within a region

shared.zh: 棋盘：每格 cell 宽；可限在一块区域里
shared.en: a checkerboard, its squares cell wide; optionally within a region

about.zh: 四个角 [x, y]，按一圈的顺序
about.en: four corners [x, y], in order around

shared.zh: 四边形：比如斜放的一张纸
shared.en: a four-sided patch, such as a sheet of paper lying askew

shared.zh: 一行行字：每行是一串长短不一的短划，gap 是行距（默认 3 格）
shared.en: lines of text: each a run of words of varying length, gap rows apart (3 by default)

shared.zh: 有起伏时画的是表面朝向（三通道：右、下、朝相机的分量）：每项一个圆形的凸起（height > 0）或凹坑（< 0）
shared.en: with a relief the picture is the surface normal (three channels: right, down, towards the camera): each item a round bump (height > 0) or dent (< 0)

shared.zh: 每格各自起伏（默认），或每行、每列一个起伏（传感器的条纹）
shared.en: each cell its own (the default), or one per row or column (a sensor’s banding)

shared.zh: 加上的随机起伏：每格 ±amp 以内，种子定下是哪一张
shared.en: random variation added, within ±amp a cell, the seed saying which

shared.zh: 按输入名给的值；没给的取第一个测试的
shared.en: values by input name; the rest are the first test’s

shared.zh: 样张：一张较大的图，玩家的板和参考解都在上面跑，只看效果、不判定
shared.en: the sample: a larger picture the player’s board and the reference both run on, to see the effect, never judged

shared.zh: filter：黑盒真正用的核（奇数宽高），按互相关排布
shared.en: filter: the kernel the black box really uses (odd sides), laid out for correlation

shared.zh: filter：每题几种互相竞争的解释（各是一个核），答案是黑盒的核
shared.en: filter: each question’s competing explanations (a kernel each); the answer is the box’s kernel

shared.zh: 根据给定位置或权重计算中间量，可填入结果格
shared.en: compute intermediate values from declared positions or weights and transfer them to result cells

shared.zh: 图怎么给玩家看：数、画面、两样都看（默认两样）
shared.en: how the image is shown: numbers, picture or both (both by default)

shared.zh: 和这个 ask 的答案同形：一行行的数，或 { x, y }
shared.en: shaped as the ask’s answer: rows of numbers, or { x, y }

shared.zh: 知识点要纠正的那个错误答案和它为什么错：npm run check 查它判错；玩家交出它时，屏幕说出为什么错
shared.en: the wrong answer the point corrects and why it is wrong: npm run check checks it fails; when the player gives it, the screen says why

shared.zh: 这一轮除了图以外玩家知道的事，显示在图旁边（一轮的前提不写进某一题的题干）
shared.en: what the player knows in this round besides the picture, shown beside it (a premise of the round, never inside one item’s prompt)

shared.zh: 绕 at 转的相机：方位、俯仰（度）、距离、焦距
shared.en: a camera orbiting `at`: yaw, pitch (degrees), distance, focal length

shared.zh: 平行光：方位、高度（度），强度，环境光
shared.en: directional light: azimuth, elevation (degrees), intensity, ambient

shared.zh: 这一轮的候选场景（claims 在它们上面算）：都得渲出同一张图（npm run check 查）
shared.en: the round’s candidate scenes (claims are judged on them): they must all render one picture (npm run check checks)

about.zh: 玩家能自己转视角、调光的场景
about.en: a scene the player turns and relights

shared.zh: 一轮一轮答：第一轮公开，后面的换了数据，答对一轮才出下一轮
shared.en: answered round by round: the first shown, the later ones with changed data, each after the one before is right

shared.zh: 每一轮、每一题选的选项 id
shared.en: the option ids picked, a list a round, a list an item

shared.zh: 知识点要纠正的那个错误答法和它为什么错：npm run check 查它在某一轮判错；玩家在那一轮交出它时，屏幕说出为什么错
shared.en: the wrong picks the point corrects and why they are wrong: npm run check checks they fail a round; when the player gives them there, the screen says why

shared.zh: 起始值（阶段的 start 优先）
shared.en: the starting value (a stage’s start comes first)

shared.zh: 在图上拖动来设，不另画控件
shared.en: set by dragging on a picture, no control of its own

about.zh: 一列东西（在图上点出的点对）
about.en: a list of things (pairs picked on a picture)

about.zh: 这一步能动的旋钮（不写：全部）
about.en: the knobs this step opens (none given: all)

about.zh: 模型可以按这个名字换按钮上的字
about.en: the name the model may relabel the button by
can be pressed while a run goes on

shared.zh: 目标怎样判：live 随旋钮实时判（默认）；submit 只在玩家按「检查」时判，在那之前目标的读数和画面里的结果都不显示，玩家要先想好再试
shared.en: how the goal is judged: live as the knobs turn (the default); submit only when the player presses Check, the goal's readings and the result in the pictures hidden until then, so the player thinks before trying

shared.zh: 主卡和旁栏的宽：各半，旁栏窄（300–340px），旁栏宽（340–430px）
shared.en: the main card against the side: half each, a narrow side (300–340px), a wide side (340–430px)

shared.zh: 玩家容易试的错误设置（step：第几步，默认 1），每个都必须达不到目标（npm run check 查）
shared.en: settings a player is likely to try that are wrong (step: which step, 1 by default), each of which must miss the goal (npm run check checks)

shared.zh: 这一课要教的关系：每个达到目标的设置也都得满足它（npm run check 把旋钮的每个取值都试一遍）
shared.en: the relation the bench teaches: every setting that meets the goal must meet these too (npm run check tries every value of the knobs)

shared.zh: 依次做的任务，最后一个通过就通过这一关
shared.en: the tasks done in turn; passing the last passes the level
